edition_angle: Focusing on neurostructural and functional alterations linked to executive dysfunction in young populations living with chronic viral infection.

assignments.angle: Mapping structural and functional brain alterations—including cortical thinning, reduced volume, and altered cerebral blood flow—underlying executive function deficits in young people living with HIV.
assignments.reason: This systematic review provides specific neuroimaging and biophysical correlates (cortical thickness, volume, mean diffusivity, cerebral blood flow) of cognitive alterations in AYALH, filling a critical gap in Luminous Mind/Dark Mirror perspectives.
